name: moai-lang-php
Use Read (read_file), Bash (terminal). PHP 8.4+, PHPUnit 11, Composer, PSR-12; Laravel/Symfony. Follow language best practices
Use latest stable tool versions
Maintain test coverage ≥85%
Document all public APIs
Skip quality gates
Use deprecated tools
Ignore security warnings
Mix testing frameworks
Support TDD, TRUST 5, code review, `/alfred:2-run`, and framework patterns. Integrate `moai-foundation-langs` and `moai-foundation-trust`. Review TRUST 5; handle missing tools/dependencies and coverage <85%.
